body:
## Outcome

Provide Bloxwap controls for discrete choices and adjustments with consistent state and feedback hooks.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Implement Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch, SegmentedControl, Tabs selection primitive, Slider/range, and Select/Picker based on actual usage.
- Use native controls or targeted accessible primitives where they preserve expected platform behavior; define when custom rendering is needed.
- Specify selection/focus/disabled/busy states, keyboard step/page/home/end behavior where applicable, drag cancellation, native accessibility increments, and RTL.
- Expose semantic selection/change events so feedback can be composed once at accepted state changes rather than on every render or duplicate pointer/click event.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both platforms have documented control mappings, controlled/uncontrolled examples, and all required states.
- [ ] Labels, groups, selected/checked values, keyboard and screen-reader adjustment work as documented.
- [ ] Controlled state rejection, repeated values, disabled controls, drags, and nested controls do not emit duplicate actions or feedback.
- [ ] Slider feedback is rate-limited by semantic steps and respects sound/haptic preferences without introducing latency.

## Prerequisites

- #14 — Build text input and form-field primitives for React and RN

## References

- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Pro](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/pro/src/components/ui)

- [Sfx](https://github.com/bloxwap/sfx/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Haptic](https://github.com/bloxwap/haptic/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Build selection, toggle, range, and segmented controls for React and RN
